name: 燃油喷射压力系统计算

map.输入喷油嘴流量、轨压、喷油脉宽与发动机参数，计算压力修正后的喷油量、燃油流量与空: Enter injector flow, rail pressure, injection pulse width and engine parameters to compute the pressure-corrected injection quantity, fuel flow and air-fuel ratio.
map.实际流量 = 额定流量 × √(实际轨压 ÷ 额定压力): Actual flow = rated flow × √(actual rail pressure ÷ rated pressure)
map.单次喷油量 = 实际流量 × 喷油脉宽 ÷ 60000 [cc]: Per-injection quantity = actual flow × injection pulse width ÷ 60000  [cc]
map.总燃油流量 = 单次喷油量 × (缸数 ÷ 2) × 转速 [cc/min]: Total fuel flow = per-injection quantity × (cylinders ÷ 2) × engine speed  [cc/min]
map.空气流量 = 排量 × (充气效率 ÷ 100) × (转速 ÷ 2) × 空气: Air flow = displacement × (volumetric efficiency ÷ 100) × (engine speed ÷ 2) × air density (1.225)
map.空燃比 AFR = 空气流量质量 ÷ 燃油流量质量: Air-fuel ratio AFR = air mass flow ÷ fuel mass flow
map.喷油占空比 = 喷油脉宽 ÷ 可用脉宽(120000 ÷ 转速) × 100%: Injector duty cycle = injection pulse width ÷ available pulse width (120000 ÷ engine speed) × 100%
map.说明：喷油量与压差平方根成正比（轨压升高喷油量增加）；汽油理论空燃比 14.7:: Note: injection quantity scales with the square root of the pressure difference (higher rail pressure means more fuel); the theoretical gasoline AFR is 14.7:1, λ=1 is ideal, λ>1.1 is lean and λ<0.9 rich.
map.💡 实际流量 = 额定流量×√(轨压÷额定压)；单次喷油 = 实际流量×脉宽÷6: 💡 Actual flow = rated flow × √(rail pressure ÷ rated pressure); per-injection quantity = actual flow × pulse width ÷ 60000; air-fuel ratio = air flow ÷ fuel flow
map.汽油理论空燃比(AFR)为 14.7:1，λ=1 为理论混合气: The theoretical gasoline AFR is 14.7:1, and λ=1 is the ideal mixture
map.充气效率反映实际负荷，怠速约 20~30%，全负荷 80~95%: Volumetric efficiency reflects real load: about 20~30% at idle and 80~95% at full load
map.轨压升高喷油量增加（与压差平方根成正比），高压直喷可达 200bar: Higher rail pressure raises injected quantity (proportional to the square root of the differential); high-pressure direct injection reaches 200bar
map.📚 深度解析：机油与燃油压力计算: 📚 In-depth: Engine Oil and Fuel Pressure Calculation
map.仪表或诊断仪读机油压力，对照转速区间判断是否偏低，定位泵或轴瓦磨损。: Read oil pressure on the gauge or scan tool and compare against the speed band to judge whether it is low, locating pump or bearing wear.
map.共轨柴油机核对轨压与目标值偏差，排查喷油器或高压泵故障。: On common-rail diesels compare rail pressure with the target to trace injector or high-pressure pump faults.
map.保养后验证冷启动油压建立速度，确认集滤器与泵正常。: After service, verify how quickly cold-start oil pressure builds to confirm the pickup screen and pump are healthy.
map.机油压力随转速变化: Oil pressure varies with engine speed
map.机油压力≈转速正相关，怠速约 1–2 bar、3000rpm 约 4–5 bar: Oil pressure tracks engine speed roughly linearly: about 1–2 bar at idle and 4–5 bar at 3000rpm. Only 0.5 bar at idle that fails to rise under acceleration usually means pump wear or a blocked pickup screen; common-rail diesels idle around 300–500 bar of rail pressure and reach 1600–2000 bar at full load.
map.机油压力低有哪些危害？: What harm comes from low oil pressure?
map.油膜建立不足会加剧轴瓦、凸轮轴磨损，严重时拉缸抱轴。发现报警应立即熄火检查，不可: An inadequate oil film accelerates wear on bearings and camshafts, and in severe cases scores the bores or seizes the bearings. Stop the engine immediately when the warning appears and never keep driving.
map.燃油轨压异常怎么查？: How do I trace abnormal fuel rail pressure?
map.先看低压油路（滤芯、输油泵）再查高压泵与调压阀，轨压过低多为泄漏或泵衰，过高多为: Check the low-pressure side first (filter, transfer pump), then the high-pressure pump and pressure valve; low rail pressure usually means a leak or pump decline, high pressure usually a stuck return valve.
map.燃油喷射压力系统计算器，根据喷油嘴流量、轨压、喷油脉宽和发动机工况，计算压力修正: The fuel injection pressure system calculator derives pressure-corrected injection quantity, fuel consumption and air-fuel ratio from injector flow, rail pressure, injection pulse width and engine operating conditions, for EFI analysis and diagnostics.
map.轨压流量平方根修正: Square-root correction of flow against rail pressure
map.如何使用燃油喷射压力系统计算: How to use Fuel Injection Pressure System Calculator
map.输入喷油嘴流量、额定与实际轨压、喷油脉宽、缸数、转速、排量与充气效率，点击计算即: Enter injector flow rate, rated and actual rail pressure, injection pulse width, cylinder count, engine speed, displacement and volumetric efficiency, then click Calculate to assess whether injection quantity matches the actual rail pressure.
